description: This file defines policies for block replication in Apache Spark, including interfaces and implementations for prioritizing peers for block replication, with classes for random and topology-aware policies.

classes.name: BlockReplicationPolicy
classes.description: Trait defining the interface for block replication prioritization policies.

classes.name: RandomBlockReplicationPolicy
classes.description: Implementation of BlockReplicationPolicy that prioritizes peers randomly, ensuring blocks are placed on different hosts if possible.

classes.name: BasicBlockReplicationPolicy
classes.description: Implementation of BlockReplicationPolicy that mimics HDFS behavior, prioritizing peers within the same rack, outside the rack, and then randomly.

methods.name: getSampleIds
methods.description: Uses Robert Floyd's sampling algorithm to find a random sample of unique indices efficiently.

methods.name: getRandomSample
methods.description: Returns a random sample of size m from a sequence, shuffling if necessary.

methods.name: prioritize
methods.description: Method in classes implementing BlockReplicationPolicy to prioritize peers for block replication.
